name: Elden Ring — Eco Balance
description: Keeps a CPU-heavy open-world game smooth by parking browsers and music in Windows 11 Efficiency Mode instead of suspending them: they keep running, but the scheduler treats them as expendable until the game exits.
notes: Efficiency Mode needs Windows 11. On Windows 10 the throttling calls report failure and the rest of the profile still applies.
Unlike suspension, Efficiency Mode never pauses downloads, voice chat or playback — it only deprioritises them.
The optimizer, the shell, audio and security processes are excluded automatically and cannot be listed as targets.
